description: Verify MCP transport and tool execution without touching a backend.
name: mcp_ping

description: Terminate only the Studio run bound to this MCP request. This stops the run without changing or archiving its ticket. A committed handoff keeps the run alive and returns "continued_by_handoff" so its queued destination prompt can run.
name: terminate_current_run

description: Add one transition to a type's workflow at the supplied revision.
name: add_issue_type_workflow_transition

description: Add a dependency edge: task_id is blocked by blocker_task_id.
name: add_task_blocker

description: Add a reverse dependency edge: dependent_task_id depends on task_id.
name: add_task_dependent

description: Add tags to a task. Existing tags are preserved and duplicate tags are returned once.
name: add_task_tags

description: Append text to the existing description of a task.
name: append_task_description

description: Attach a local file to a task.
name: attach_file

description: Delete one state's launch binding and its auto-start setting.
name: clear_issue_type_workflow_launch_binding

description:
Create an Implementation finding under a Story in Review (#905).

The dedicated review-finding surface: one call creates a direct
Implementation child, parented to a Story currently in ``Review``, born
directly in the Implementation workflow's start stage, with a fixed
evidence-block description — ``Path`` (repo-relative), inclusive
``Lines`` (``line_start``..``line_end``), and an optional ``Note``. Findings
under one Story form a serial chain: each new finding is blocked by the
latest preceding Implementation child when one exists.

Returns ``{"ok": True, "task_id", "key"}`` on success. On rejection it
returns ``{"ok": False, ...}`` with a machine-readable reason instead of
raising: malformed evidence locally (implausible path, or a
non-inclusive / non-positive line range), and — from the backend gate — a
parent that is not a Story, a parent not in ``Review``, or a
foreign-project parent (``detail``/``code``/``from``/``to``).

It never launches an agent, moves the parent's state, or touches the scheduler.
name: create_review_finding

description: Create a sub-task with an explicit type, optionally in a named state.
name: create_sub_task

description: Create a task with an explicit type, optionally in a named state.
name: create_task

description:
Launch eligible direct children of a root task.

Only direct children participate. Each child launches once after every
blocker reaches a satisfying workflow state; a durable ledger prevents
later re-launches.

Passing ``reset=True`` clears that root's ledger first, then executes
newly launchable direct children. The default leaves the ledger intact.

Returns ``root_id`` and task ids launched by this call.
name: execute_dependency_graph

description:
Read a task subtree's workflow states and dependency edges.

Returns the root plus factual nodes carrying ``id``, workflow-state
``state``, ``parent_id``, and ``blocked_by`` ids. This read never
launches agents and does not depend on an execution run.
name: get_dependency_graph

description:
Read one issue type's live workflow policy.

Returns its start state, revision-guarded transition map with agent
permissions, launch bindings with auto-start, and standing warnings.
name: get_issue_type_workflow_settings

description: Read the goals with G-numbers for an open sprint in your project.
name: get_sprint_goals

description: Get detailed information about a specific task using its ID or Key (e.g. PROJ-123).
name: get_task_details

description:
Read a task's dependency slice: which tasks it depends on, which
depend on it, which are owned elsewhere, plus an advisory summary.
ID may be a UUID or a key (e.g. PROJ-123). Read-only.
name: get_task_scope_context

description:
Launch the default coding agent for one work item (#924).

Starts a normal, task-scoped coding session for the target ticket: the
prompt is built from that ticket's own context (you cannot pass prompt
text), and the current-state binding selects the provider. ``id_or_key`` is the
target's UUID or key (e.g. ``PROJ-123``).

Returns ``{"target_id", "agent", "agent_run_id"}`` once the run
is durably launched — the agent then continues on its own in a detached
terminal. On a backend rejection it returns ``{"target_id", "error"}``
instead of raising (unknown target, no module ancestry, no selected
profile). This is a single interactive launch: it starts no orchestration
run, dependency graph, or planning phase, and never moves the target's
workflow state. Repeated calls each start a fresh run.
name: launch_default_coding_agent

description:
List a project's configurable issue types.

Each row carries its ``level`` bucket (``module`` vs ``task``). Use it
to map a selected type name to the id the create tools require.
name: list_issue_types

description: List a project's modules (issues of level ``module``, e.g. Epics).
name: list_modules

description: List all projects in the worktracker.
name: list_projects

description: List tasks (work items) in a project, optionally filtered by module or state.
name: list_tasks

description: Remove one transition from a type's workflow at the supplied revision.
name: remove_issue_type_workflow_transition

description:
Rename a Codex conversation by its Codex thread id.

Codex owns thread names in its own on-disk state, so this writes through
the one resident ``codex app-server`` Ticketry already reads titles from.
Both arguments are trimmed and must be non-blank; whitespace inside the
name is preserved and no Ticketry id or length rule applies.

Returns ``{"ok": true, "thread_id", "name"}``. Failures return a
structured ``{"ok": false, "error": ..., "detail": ...}`` result:
``invalid_input``, ``codex_thread_not_found``,
``codex_app_server_unavailable``, or ``codex_app_server_error``.

It never starts, resumes, or forks a thread, and touches no Ticketry row.
name: rename_codex_thread

description:
Reparent existing work items under a parent work item.

Both parent_task_id and each entry in task_ids may be a UUID or a
worktracker key (e.g. "VEEVI-68"). If module_id is omitted, the
reparented tasks inherit the parent's module. Returns a dict with keys:
parent_task_id, reparented, skipped, failed.
name: reparent_tasks

description:
Convert an eligible childless Story to an Implementation task in Implement and launch its agent with the Implementation launch settings, as one action.

``id_or_key`` accepts a work-item UUID or key. The work item keeps its identity, key, content, and relationships. Rust owns refusal, destination-policy preflight, the guarded conversion, and task-scoped launch ordering. Refusals are returned as structured results; ``committed_state`` and ``committed_issue_type`` are present only when the conversion committed.
name: run_now

description: Toggle auto-start; enabling requires a valid launch binding.
name: set_issue_type_workflow_auto_start

description: Set the issue type's start state at the supplied revision.
name: set_issue_type_workflow_start_state

description: Update policy on one existing transition.
name: set_issue_type_workflow_transition_permission

description: Replace the tasks that block a task. IDs may be UUIDs or keys.
name: set_task_blockers

description: Record a suggestion for the current sprint suggestion run. Supply issue_id alone, or proposed_name and proposed_epic_id. This never assigns a story to a sprint.
name: suggest_sprint_story

description: Replace a task's supplied title and/or full description.
name: update_task

description:
Update the status/state of a task (e.g. 'Todo', 'Done').

Returns ``{"ok": True, ...}`` on success, or ``{"ok": False, ...}`` with
the gate's structured reason (``detail``/``code``/``from``/``to``) when
the backend refuses an illegal workflow move (#872).

This tool always identifies the write as agent-origin, so the configured
graph and its agent permissions govern the move.
name: update_task_status

description: Create or replace one state's launch binding at the supplied revision.
name: upsert_issue_type_workflow_launch_binding
